learning.priority: Reproduce the shared-coordinate visual contract and variable-specific encodings after inspecting the publication and author outputs.
learning.independent_implementation: BioFigure independently generates fixed-seed structural data and renders the complete b-e composition in R.
learning.data_role: Synthetic values exercise the visual grammar; no numerical, biological-effect, or pixel-identity claim is made.
learning.layout_rules: One coordinate system is reused across continuous, categorical, six-feature and binary views. Small multiples suppress duplicate axes; continuous guides remain outside the data region.
learning.failure_modes: Reject per-panel coordinate recomputation, palette-type mismatch, six independently scaled undocumented protein legends, nested-panel tag drift, and legend overlap.
